title: Repeat
prompt: Return text repeated n times. ("ab", 3) gives "ababab"; zero times gives an empty string.
hints: Start with an empty result and add text to it in a loop, or use repeat().

docs.name: text.repeat(n)
docs.what: Returns the text repeated n times.

docs.name: for c in text:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per character, with c holding each one.
